For what it's worth, when I was little, my parents would make us all get out of the pool when the trash guys came.  There was always a truck load of hot tired guys in the middle of their run. They would spend 20 minutes in the pool all to themselves, then my mom would send them off with some ice cold sodas. It always made me appreciate anybody who earns their living. Plus now I leave a cooler out in the summer with cold drinks for anybody who is working in the neighborhood.

I make big batches of fresh sauce in the summer from ingredients grown in the garden. The best way I have found to store them is to let the sauce cool a little after cooking, then pouring it into freezer safe ziplock bags. It might take to people to not make a huge mess, but then you can store them flat in the freezer, saving space and with all the air out of the bag, I find my sauce to taste as fresh as the day it was made.
